name: Holesail Switchboard
description:
Running the server behind a home router (NAT) without a public domain? Tor is too slow?

Holesail Switchboard provides a web interface to manage multiple holesail servers and clients, allowing you to create instant P2P tunnels that bypass any network, firewall, or NAT restrictions.

Features:
  - Create and manage multiple P2P servers and clients from a single dashboard
  - QR code generation for easy sharing of server connection URLs
  - Secure mode support for private connections
  - Persistent configuration that survives restarts


Use cases:
  - Expose your the server apps to the internet without port forwarding
  - Share access to local services with friends and family
  - Connect to remote services securely

For more information: https://github.com/oren-z0/holesail-switchboard/blob/main/docs/the server.md
short_desc: Manage multiple holesail P2P tunnels from a single dashboard
author: oren-z0
